description: This file is a shell script providing a testing library for running and managing a git-daemon process during tests. It includes functions to start and stop the daemon, set up fixtures such as FIFOs, and simulate network connections.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a git daemon process with specific parameters, ensuring only one instance runs and capturing its output to verify readiness.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon process, cleans up related files and handles termination signals.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: Simulates a netcat-like network client using Perl to connect to a specified host:port, send input, and output the response.
